entry.title: Proof-of-work based signet faucet
entry.summary:
A stratum v1 compatible miner can be tested for functionality by directing it to the inq pool at port 3333. The mining process involves rolling the nonce, nVersion, and the "coinbase" extranonce within the work assignments provided by this pool. Successful manipulation of these values, when the required difficulty is achieved, will result in payouts. This approach should generally ensure proper operation of the miner.
However, despite these expectations, there may be unforeseen issues due to the lack of robust standardization within the stratum v1 protocol. Variations in implementation across different miners or pools could potentially lead to unexpected behavior or incompatibility, so results may vary depending on the specific software used.
